base_member_text: UUsum etc. subtract U_davg_mean computed from the PREVIOUS window inside both branches (L171-173, L285-287) — first-window accumulations subtract the initial zero mean; cross-line dependency
audit_member_text: ETA2sum at L157/L278 measures deviations from ETAmean, but ETAmean is updated only at interval completion L165 and then held through the next interval. UUsum/UVsum/VVsum at L171-L173 and L285-L287 similarly use prior-window U_davg_mean/V_davg_mean and ETAmean. The reported ETA2mean and radiation moments are therefore centered on the previous interval's means, not the same samples' means; no correction term is applied when the mean changes.

base_member_text: window-closing branch adds the final step to the sums and immediately computes means before resetting, but the reset keeps T_sum remainder (T_sum=T_sum-T_INTV_mean @L235, ykchoi's own comment questions whether it should be ZERO) — the first window after reset divides fresh sums by a T_sum that starts at the remainder, biasing the next means; unresolved intent
audit_member_text: When a step crosses T_INTV_mean, the full current DT is added to all sums at L154-L178 and used in the completed mean, but L235 retains T_sum-T_INTV_mean while L236-L253 reset every sum to zero. The retained fractional time has no corresponding retained integral, so the next interval's denominator includes unrepresented time and biases all means low after non-exact interval crossings.

base_member_text: Num_Zero_Up/HavgSum/HrmsSum are never reset (reset lines commented out @L264-266), so WaveHeightAve/RMS are running statistics over the entire post-STEADY_TIME run, not per averaging window
audit_member_text: Num_Zero_Up, HavgSum and HrmsSum resets are commented out at L264-L266 while interval sums reset at L235-L253. Consequently WaveHeightAve/RMS at L261-L262 are cumulative across all prior waves, whereas SigWaveHeight and the mean/radiation fields are interval products; whether that mixed temporal basis is intended is not established in the routine.

base_member_text: MIXING_STUFF gate uses 'time' (lowercase) >= STEADY_TIME @L71 while the header comment says mean eta is also calculated — STEADY_TIME/T_INTV_mean default to LARGE in io.f90 so averaging is off unless configured (cross-file)
hard-coded 9.80 (L198,L204,L206) and 4.004 (L255) rather than GRAV — inconsistency with GRAV used elsewhere
Tmpe/Tmp_0 comparison uses Zero (capitalized) @L301 from PARAM (cross-file); DXg/DYg, Wsurf, BreakSourceX/Y, Cd, U_davg etc. all cross-file

audit_member_text: Wave extrema/upcrossing detection exists only in the T_sum<T_INTV_mean ELSE branch L294-L312. The sample that reaches/crosses the interval threshold follows the IF branch and contributes to time sums L157-L178 but is skipped by Emax/Emin and zero-upcrossing logic, dropping one wave-detection sample at every mean-output boundary.
